# Job Chapter 32 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 428r–428v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/JOB_032_page_001.jpg, JOB_032_page_002.jpg

---

**32:1** And-ceased [vayishbetu] these three men from-answering [me'anot] Iyyov, because he [was] righteous [tsaddiq] in-his-own-eyes [be'einav].

**32:2** And-burned [vayichar] the-anger [af] of-Elihu [Elihu] son of-Barachel [Barakh'el] the-Buzite [ha-Buzi], of-the-family of-Ram [mishpachat Ram]; against Iyyov his-anger [apo] burned [charah] because he-justified [tsaddiq] himself [nafsho] rather-than [me-] God [Elohim].

**32:3** And-against his-three friends his-anger burned, because [al asher] they-had-not found [lo mats'u] an-answer [ma'aneh], and-yet-they-had-condemned [vayarshi'u] Iyyov.

**32:4** And-Elihu had-waited [chikkah] for [et] Iyyov with-words [bi-devarim], because they [were] older [zeqenim] in-days [le-yamim] than-he [mimmenu].

**32:5** And-saw [vayar] Elihu that-there-was-no answer [ma'aneh] in-the-mouth of-the-three men, and-his-anger [apo] burned [vayichar].

**32:6** And-answered Elihu son of-Barakhel the-Buzite and-said: "Young [tsa'ir] I [am] in-days [le-yamim], and-you [are] aged [yeshishim]; therefore [al ken] I-was-afraid [zachalti] and-I-feared [va'ira] to-declare [me-chavvot] my-knowledge [de'i] to-you [etkhem].

**32:7** I-said [amarti], 'Days [yamim] shall-speak [yedabberu], and-multitude of-years [rov shanim] shall-make-known [yodi'u] wisdom [chokmah].'

**32:8** But [akhen] it-is the-spirit [ruach] in-man [enosh], and-the-breath of-the-Almighty [nishmat Shaddai] [that] gives-them-understanding [tevinem].

**32:9** Not the-great [rabbim] [are] wise [yachkemu], and-[not] the-aged [zeqenim] [who] understand [yavinu] justice [mishpat].

**32:10** Therefore I-say [amarti], 'Listen [shim'ah] to-me; I-also [af ani] will-declare [achavveh] my-knowledge [de'i].'

**32:11** Behold, I-waited [hochalti] for-your-words [le-divreikhem]; I-listened [azin] to-your-arguments [ad tevunotekhem], until [ad] you-searched-out [tachqerun] words [millin].

**32:12** And-to-you I-gave-attention [etbonen], and-behold, there-is-no one-who-reproves [mokhiach] Iyyov, [no one who] answers [oneh] his-words [amarav] among-you [mikkem].

**32:13** Lest [pen] you-say [tomeru], 'We-have-found [matsa'nu] wisdom [chokmah]'; God [El] will-thrust-him-away [yiddefennu], not a-man [lo ish].

**32:14** And-he-has-not directed [lo arakh] words [millin] against-me [elai], and-with-your-words [be-imreikhem] I-will-not answer-him [lo ashivennu].

**32:15** They-are-dismayed [chattu]; they-do-not answer [anu] again [od]; they-have-removed [he'etiqu] words [millin] from-themselves [me-hem].

**32:16** And-I-waited [vehochalti], for they-do-not speak [lo yedabberu]; for they-stand-still [amadu] — they-do-not answer [anu] again [od].

**32:17** I-will-answer [e'eneh] — I also [af ani] — my-portion [chelqi]; I-also [af ani] will-declare [achavveh] my-knowledge [de'i].

**32:18** For I-am-full [maleti] of-words [millin]; the-spirit [ruach] of-my-belly [vitni] constrains-me [hetsiqatni].

**32:19** Behold, my-belly [vitni] [is] like-wine [ke-yayin] [that] has-not-been-opened [lo yippateach]; like-new [chadashim] wineskins [ke-ovot] it-is-about-to-burst [yibbaqe'a].

**32:20** I-will-speak [adabbrah] and-it-will-be-a-relief [veyirvach] for-me; I-will-open [eftach] my-lips [sefatai] and-I-will-answer [ve'e'eneh].

**32:21** I-will-not lift [lo essa] the-face [penei] of-a-man [ish], and-to-a-man [el adam] I-will-not give-flattering-titles [lo akanneh].

**32:22** For I-do-not know [lo yadati] to-give-flattering-titles [akanneh]; in-a-little [ki me'at] my-Maker [oseni] would-carry-me-away [yissa'eni]."

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.2 — "Elihu son of Barachel the Buzite":** Elihu is the only speaker in the dialogues given a genealogy — name, patronymic, clan, and family. The detail suggests either a late addition or the author's desire to establish Elihu's credentials. *Elihu* means "He is my God"; *Barachel* means "God has blessed."

**v.3 — Tiqqun Sopherim:** The MT reads "they had condemned Job" (*vayarshi'u et Iyyov*), but an ancient scribal tradition (tiqqunei soferim) notes that the original text read "they had condemned God" — the scribes altered it to avoid blasphemy.

**v.8 — "the spirit in man, and the breath of the Almighty":** Elihu claims a democratic source for wisdom — not age but divine inspiration. This echoes Genesis 2:7 (the breath of life) and anticipates Joel 2:28 (the spirit poured out on all flesh).

**v.19 — "like wine that has not been opened":** Elihu compares himself to a wineskin about to burst with fermented words. The image is vivid but also slightly comic — Elihu's self-importance is palpable.

*— EMET*
